name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(key_lost) is the correct form of the ban, since key_lost is defined as dropping the key while the door is still closed (before it has been opened), so the 'until the door has been opened once' condition is already built into the proposition and no Precedence is needed; hard Existence(at_goal) covers 'Reach the goal', and the machine correctly rejects on key_lost and finishes on at_goal.

texts: The key is never dropped while the door is closed before it has been opened.
The agent eventually reaches the goal.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
